/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Zoomable Canvas Link-Profile Viewport Model & Renderer
 *
 * Provides an independent, zoomable, and pannable viewport for the authoritative
 * worker-generated link profile. Gestures and viewport state are strictly isolated
 * from simulation state, trajectory edits, obstacle edits, and map interactions.
 */

import type { LinkProfile, LinkProfileObstacleInterval, LinkProfileSample } from '../core/linkProfile';

export interface ViewportBounds {
  readonly minDKm: number;
  readonly maxDKm: number;
  readonly minAltM: number;
  readonly maxAltM: number;
}

export interface ViewportLayout {
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
  readonly padL: number;
  readonly padR: number;
  readonly padT: number;
  readonly padB: number;
}

export interface ProfileStatusSummary {
  readonly terrainIsLos: boolean;
  readonly obstacleBlocked: boolean;
  readonly terrainClearanceM: number;
  readonly diffractionLossDb: number;
  readonly primaryBlockedObstacleId: string | null;
  readonly terrainStatusText: string;
  readonly terrainBadgeClass: string;
  readonly obstacleStatusText: string;
  readonly obstacleBadgeClass: string;
}

/** Minimum and maximum physical limits for the viewport to prevent inversion or arithmetic overflow. */
export const VIEWPORT_LIMITS = {
  MIN_SPAN_D_KM: 0.05,       // 50 metres min horizontal view span
  MAX_SPAN_D_KM: 1200.0,     // 1,200 km max domain span
  MIN_SPAN_ALT_M: 10.0,      // 10 metres min elevation span
  MAX_SPAN_ALT_M: 30000.0,   // 30,000 metres max elevation span
  MIN_DOMAIN_D_KM: -100.0,
  MAX_DOMAIN_D_KM: 1300.0,
  MIN_DOMAIN_ALT_M: -1000.0,
  MAX_DOMAIN_ALT_M: 35000.0,
  MAX_ZOOM_FACTOR: 50.0,
  MIN_ZOOM_FACTOR: 0.2,
} as const;

export function calcNiceStep(range: number, targetTicks = 5): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(range) || range <= 0) return 1;
  const safeTicks = Math.max(1, targetTicks);
  const raw = range / safeTicks;
  const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.max(raw, 1e-9))));
  const n = raw / mag;
  const mult = n < 1.5 ? 1 : n < 3 ? 2 : n < 7 ? 5 : 10;
  return mult * mag;
}

/**
 * Encapsulates the viewport coordinates, zoom/pan transforms, and fit calculations.
 * Pure TypeScript with no direct DOM dependency, allowing 100% headless testability.
 */
export class LinkProfileViewportState {
  private minDKm: number = 0;
  private maxDKm: number = 10;
  private minAltM: number = 0;
  private maxAltM: number = 5000;

  private fitMinDKm: number = 0;
  private fitMaxDKm: number = 10;
  private fitMinAltM: number = 0;
  private fitMaxAltM: number = 5000;

  private userModified: boolean = false;
  private lastSelectedNodeId: number | null = null;

  constructor() {
    this.resetToDefaults();
  }

  public resetToDefaults(): void {
    this.minDKm = 0;
    this.maxDKm = 10;
    this.minAltM = 0;
    this.maxAltM = 5000;
    this.fitMinDKm = 0;
    this.fitMaxDKm = 10;
    this.fitMinAltM = 0;
    this.fitMaxAltM = 5000;
    this.userModified = false;
    this.lastSelectedNodeId = null;
  }

  public get bounds(): ViewportBounds {
    return {
      minDKm: this.minDKm,
      maxDKm: this.maxDKm,
      minAltM: this.minAltM,
      maxAltM: this.maxAltM,
    };
  }

  public get fitBounds(): ViewportBounds {
    return {
      minDKm: this.fitMinDKm,
      maxDKm: this.fitMaxDKm,
      minAltM: this.fitMinAltM,
      maxAltM: this.fitMaxAltM,
    };
  }

  public get isUserModified(): boolean {
    return this.userModified;
  }

  public get zoomFactor(): number {
    const fitSpanD = Math.max(0.001, this.fitMaxDKm - this.fitMinDKm);
    const currSpanD = Math.max(0.001, this.maxDKm - this.minDKm);
    return Math.round((fitSpanD / currSpanD) * 10) / 10;
  }

  /**
   * Updates reference profile geometry.
   * Automatically resets fit when node selection changes or when no manual pan/zoom is active.
   */
  public syncProfile(profile: LinkProfile | null, options?: { forceReset?: boolean }): boolean {
    if (!profile || !profile.valid || profile.samples.length < 2) {
      return false;
    }

    const nodeChanged = this.lastSelectedNodeId !== null && this.lastSelectedNodeId !== profile.selectedGroundNodeId;
    this.lastSelectedNodeId = profile.selectedGroundNodeId;

    // Calculate optimal fit bounds from profile geometry
    const dMaxKm = Math.max(0.1, profile.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000);
    let loAlt = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    let hiAlt = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;

    for (const s of profile.samples) {
      if (Number.isFinite(s.terrainElevationMslM)) loAlt = Math.min(loAlt, s.terrainElevationMslM);
      if (Number.isFinite(s.effectiveTerrainElevationMslM)) {
        loAlt = Math.min(loAlt, s.effectiveTerrainElevationMslM);
        hiAlt = Math.max(hiAlt, s.effectiveTerrainElevationMslM);
      }
      if (Number.isFinite(s.losElevationMslM)) {
        loAlt = Math.min(loAlt, s.losElevationMslM);
        hiAlt = Math.max(hiAlt, s.losElevationMslM);
      }
      if (Number.isFinite(s.lowerFresnelElevationMslM)) loAlt = Math.min(loAlt, s.lowerFresnelElevationMslM);
      if (Number.isFinite(s.upperFresnelElevationMslM)) hiAlt = Math.max(hiAlt, s.upperFresnelElevationMslM);
    }

    if (!Number.isFinite(loAlt) || !Number.isFinite(hiAlt) || hiAlt <= loAlt) {
      loAlt = 0;
      hiAlt = 5000;
    }

    const rawSpan = Math.max(200, hiAlt - loAlt);
    const altStep = calcNiceStep(rawSpan + 300, 5);
    const fitMinAlt = Math.floor((loAlt - 150) / altStep) * altStep;
    const fitMaxAlt = Math.ceil((hiAlt + 150) / altStep) * altStep;

    this.fitMinDKm = 0;
    this.fitMaxDKm = dMaxKm;
    this.fitMinAltM = fitMinAlt;
    this.fitMaxAltM = fitMaxAlt;

    if (options?.forceReset || nodeChanged || !this.userModified) {
      this.resetFit();
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  public resetFit(): void {
    this.minDKm = this.fitMinDKm;
    this.maxDKm = this.fitMaxDKm;
    this.minAltM = this.fitMinAltM;
    this.maxAltM = this.fitMaxAltM;
    this.userModified = false;
  }

  /**
   * Uniform zoom centered at a fractional viewport coordinate (0..1).
   * @param factor > 1 zooms in (closer view), < 1 zooms out (wider view).
   */
  public zoom(factor: number, centerFractionX = 0.5, centerFractionY = 0.5): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0 || factor === 1) return;

    const currentSpanD = this.maxDKm - this.minDKm;
    const currentSpanAlt = this.maxAltM - this.minAltM;

    let targetSpanD = currentSpanD / factor;
    let targetSpanAlt = currentSpanAlt / factor;

    // Enforce span limits
    targetSpanD = Math.max(VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_SPAN_D_KM, Math.min(VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_SPAN_D_KM, targetSpanD));
    targetSpanAlt = Math.max(VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_SPAN_ALT_M, Math.min(VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_SPAN_ALT_M, targetSpanAlt));

    const fracX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, centerFractionX));
    const fracY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, centerFractionY));

    const focusD = this.minDKm + fracX * currentSpanD;
    const focusAlt = this.minAltM + fracY * currentSpanAlt;

    let nextMinD = focusD - fracX * targetSpanD;
    let nextMaxD = nextMinD + targetSpanD;
    let nextMinAlt = focusAlt - fracY * targetSpanAlt;
    let nextMaxAlt = nextMinAlt + targetSpanAlt;

    // Clamp within global domain limits
    if (nextMinD < VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_D_KM) {
      nextMinD = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_D_KM;
      nextMaxD = nextMinD + targetSpanD;
    } else if (nextMaxD > VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_D_KM) {
      nextMaxD = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_D_KM;
      nextMinD = nextMaxD - targetSpanD;
    }

    if (nextMinAlt < VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_ALT_M) {
      nextMinAlt = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_ALT_M;
      nextMaxAlt = nextMinAlt + targetSpanAlt;
    } else if (nextMaxAlt > VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_ALT_M) {
      nextMaxAlt = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_ALT_M;
      nextMinAlt = nextMaxAlt - targetSpanAlt;
    }

    this.minDKm = nextMinD;
    this.maxDKm = nextMaxD;
    this.minAltM = nextMinAlt;
    this.maxAltM = nextMaxAlt;
    this.userModified = true;
  }

  /**
   * Pointer-centered zoom at specific canvas coordinates.
   */
  public zoomAt(factor: number, canvasX: number, canvasY: number, layout: ViewportLayout): void {
    const plotW = Math.max(1, layout.width - layout.padL - layout.padR);
    const plotH = Math.max(1, layout.height - layout.padT - layout.padB);
    const fracX = (canvasX - layout.padL) / plotW;
    const fracY = (layout.padT + plotH - canvasY) / plotH;
    this.zoom(factor, fracX, fracY);
  }

  /**
   * Pan the viewport by canvas pixel delta.
   */
  public pan(deltaPxX: number, deltaPxY: number, layout: ViewportLayout): void {
    if (!Number.isFinite(deltaPxX) || !Number.isFinite(deltaPxY)) return;
    if (deltaPxX === 0 && deltaPxY === 0) return;

    const plotW = Math.max(1, layout.width - layout.padL - layout.padR);
    const plotH = Math.max(1, layout.height - layout.padT - layout.padB);

    const spanD = this.maxDKm - this.minDKm;
    const spanAlt = this.maxAltM - this.minAltM;

    const deltaD = -(deltaPxX / plotW) * spanD;
    const deltaAlt = (deltaPxY / plotH) * spanAlt;

    let nextMinD = this.minDKm + deltaD;
    let nextMaxD = this.maxDKm + deltaD;
    let nextMinAlt = this.minAltM + deltaAlt;
    let nextMaxAlt = this.maxAltM + deltaAlt;

    if (nextMinD < VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_D_KM) {
      nextMinD = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_D_KM;
      nextMaxD = nextMinD + spanD;
    } else if (nextMaxD > VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_D_KM) {
      nextMaxD = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_D_KM;
      nextMinD = nextMaxD - spanD;
    }

    if (nextMinAlt < VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_ALT_M) {
      nextMinAlt = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MIN_DOMAIN_ALT_M;
      nextMaxAlt = nextMinAlt + spanAlt;
    } else if (nextMaxAlt > VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_ALT_M) {
      nextMaxAlt = VIEWPORT_LIMITS.MAX_DOMAIN_ALT_M;
      nextMinAlt = nextMaxAlt - spanAlt;
    }

    this.minDKm = nextMinD;
    this.maxDKm = nextMaxD;
    this.minAltM = nextMinAlt;
    this.maxAltM = nextMaxAlt;
    this.userModified = true;
  }

  // --- Coordinate Transformations ---

  public xToCanvas(dKm: number, layout: ViewportLayout): number {
    const plotW = Math.max(1, layout.width - layout.padL - layout.padR);
    const spanD = Math.max(1e-6, this.maxDKm - this.minDKm);
    return layout.padL + ((dKm - this.minDKm) / spanD) * plotW;
  }

  public yToCanvas(altM: number, layout: ViewportLayout): number {
    const plotH = Math.max(1, layout.height - layout.padT - layout.padB);
    const spanAlt = Math.max(1e-6, this.maxAltM - this.minAltM);
    return layout.padT + plotH - ((altM - this.minAltM) / spanAlt) * plotH;
  }

  public canvasToX(px: number, layout: ViewportLayout): number {
    const plotW = Math.max(1, layout.width - layout.padL - layout.padR);
    const spanD = Math.max(1e-6, this.maxDKm - this.minDKm);
    return this.minDKm + ((px - layout.padL) / plotW) * spanD;
  }

  public canvasToY(py: number, layout: ViewportLayout): number {
    const plotH = Math.max(1, layout.height - layout.padT - layout.padB);
    const spanAlt = Math.max(1e-6, this.maxAltM - this.minAltM);
    return this.minAltM + ((layout.padT + plotH - py) / plotH) * spanAlt;
  }
}

/**
 * Summarizes the authoritative physics status flags for the profile display.
 * Explicitly separates terrain line-of-sight from obstacle screening blockage.
 */
export function summarizeProfileStatus(profile: LinkProfile | null, legacyObstruction?: {
  terrainIsLos?: boolean;
  obstacleBlocked?: boolean;
  minClearanceM?: number;
  diffractionLossDb?: number;
  obstacleIntersections?: readonly { obstacleId: string }[];
}): ProfileStatusSummary {
  const terrainIsLos = profile ? profile.terrainIsLos : (legacyObstruction?.terrainIsLos ?? true);
  const obstacleBlocked = profile ? profile.obstacleBlocked : (legacyObstruction?.obstacleBlocked ?? false);
  const minClearanceM = profile ? profile.terrainMinimumClearanceM : (legacyObstruction?.minClearanceM ?? 0);
  const diffractionLossDb = profile ? profile.diffractionLossDb : (legacyObstruction?.diffractionLossDb ?? 0);

  const blockedId = profile && profile.obstacleIntervals.length > 0
    ? profile.obstacleIntervals[0].obstacleId
    : (legacyObstruction?.obstacleIntersections?.[0]?.obstacleId ?? null);

  let terrainText: string;
  let terrainClass: string;
  if (!terrainIsLos) {
    terrainText = `TERRAIN OCCLUSION (${diffractionLossDb.toFixed(1)} dB OUTAGE)`;
    terrainClass = 'kpi-badge badge-crimson';
  } else if (minClearanceM < 15) {
    terrainText = `GRAZING 0.6 F1 (${minClearanceM >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${minClearanceM.toFixed(0)}m)`;
    terrainClass = 'kpi-badge badge-amber';
  } else {
    terrainText = `PRISTINE LINE-OF-SIGHT (+${minClearanceM.toFixed(0)}m)`;
    terrainClass = 'kpi-badge badge-emerald';
  }

  let obstacleText: string;
  let obstacleClass: string;
  if (obstacleBlocked) {
    obstacleText = blockedId ? `OBSTACLE: BLOCKED [${blockedId}]` : 'OBSTACLE: BLOCKED';
    obstacleClass = 'kpi-badge badge-crimson';
  } else {
    obstacleText = 'OBSTACLES: CLEAR';
    obstacleClass = 'kpi-badge badge-emerald';
  }

  return {
    terrainIsLos,
    obstacleBlocked,
    terrainClearanceM: minClearanceM,
    diffractionLossDb,
    primaryBlockedObstacleId: blockedId,
    terrainStatusText: terrainText,
    terrainBadgeClass: terrainClass,
    obstacleStatusText: obstacleText,
    obstacleBadgeClass: obstacleClass,
  };
}

export interface RenderProfileOptions {
  readonly showFresnel?: boolean;
  readonly showObstacles?: boolean;
  readonly titlePrefix?: string;
}

/**
 * Draws the complete profile to the canvas context using typed profile geometry.
 */
export function renderLinkProfileViewport(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  layout: ViewportLayout,
  viewport: LinkProfileViewportState,
  profile: LinkProfile | null,
  legacyPoints?: readonly [number, number, number, number][] | null,
  options?: RenderProfileOptions,
): void {
  const { width: w, height: h, padL, padR, padT, padB } = layout;
  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

  const plotW = Math.max(1, w - padL - padR);
  const plotH = Math.max(1, h - padT - padB);

  // Background sky
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#0f1a27');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#0b1015');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const samples = profile && profile.valid && profile.samples.length >= 2 ? profile.samples : null;
  if (!samples && (!legacyPoints || legacyPoints.length < 2)) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7d8c99';
    ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Waiting for link profile data…', w / 2, h / 2);
    return;
  }

  const bounds = viewport.bounds;

  // Grid & Axis Ticks
  const dSpan = bounds.maxDKm - bounds.minDKm;
  const altSpan = bounds.maxAltM - bounds.minAltM;
  const dStep = calcNiceStep(dSpan, 6);
  const altStep = calcNiceStep(altSpan, 5);

  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.font = '10px ui-monospace, monospace';

  // Horizontal elevation gridlines
  const startAlt = Math.ceil(bounds.minAltM / altStep) * altStep;
  for (let alt = startAlt; alt <= bounds.maxAltM + 1e-6; alt += altStep) {
    const y = Math.round(viewport.yToCanvas(alt, layout)) + 0.5;
    if (y >= padT && y <= padT + plotH) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 160, 0.14)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
      ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#7d8c99';
      ctx.textAlign = 'right';
      ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(alt)} m`, padL - 8, y + 3);
    }
  }

  // Vertical distance gridlines
  const startD = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(bounds.minDKm / dStep) * dStep);
  for (let d = startD; d <= bounds.maxDKm + 1e-6; d += dStep) {
    const x = Math.round(viewport.xToCanvas(d, layout)) + 0.5;
    if (x >= padL && x <= padL + plotW) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120, 140, 160, 0.10)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, padT);
      ctx.lineTo(x, padT + plotH);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#7d8c99';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(String(+d.toFixed(1)), x, padT + plotH + 14);
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#7d8c99';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('km from terminal', w - padR, h - 5);

  // Clip profile data rendering strictly to the plot area
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(padL, padT, plotW, plotH);
  ctx.clip();

  // Draw typed profile or fallback
  if (samples && samples.length > 0) {
    drawTypedProfileContent(ctx, layout, viewport, profile!, samples, options);
  } else if (legacyPoints && legacyPoints.length > 0) {
    drawLegacyProfileContent(ctx, layout, viewport, legacyPoints);
  } else {
    ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace, monospace';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('NO GROUND TERMINAL SELECTED · ACN RELAY STANDBY', padL + plotW / 2, padT + plotH / 2);
  }

  ctx.restore();

  // Header info line: Path & Zoom indicator
  const dTotalKm = profile ? profile.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000 : (legacyPoints ? legacyPoints.at(-1)?.[0] ?? 0 : 0);
  const slantTotalKm = profile ? profile.slantDistanceM / 1000 : dTotalKm;
  const zoomText = viewport.isUserModified ? ` · Zoom ${viewport.zoomFactor.toFixed(1)}× (drag to pan, wheel to zoom)` : '';
  const diffLossText = profile && profile.diffractionLossDb > 0 ? ` · DiffLoss ${profile.diffractionLossDb.toFixed(1)} dB` : '';
  const prefix = options?.titlePrefix ? `${options.titlePrefix} · ` : '';

  ctx.font = '10.5px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9aa8b3';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(
    `${prefix}Ground path ${dTotalKm.toFixed(1)} km · Slant ${slantTotalKm.toFixed(1)} km${diffLossText}${zoomText}`,
    padL + 4,
    16
  );
}

function drawTypedProfileContent(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  layout: ViewportLayout,
  viewport: LinkProfileViewportState,
  profile: LinkProfile,
  samples: readonly LinkProfileSample[],
  options?: RenderProfileOptions,
): void {
  const { padT, padB, height: h } = layout;
  const plotH = Math.max(1, h - padT - padB);
  const base = padT + plotH;

  const showFresnel = options?.showFresnel !== false;
  const showObstacles = options?.showObstacles !== false;

  // 1. First Fresnel zone (0.6 F1 band)
  if (showFresnel) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      const s = samples[i];
      const x = viewport.xToCanvas(s.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const y = viewport.yToCanvas(s.upperFresnelElevationMslM, layout);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    for (let i = samples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = samples[i];
      const x = viewport.xToCanvas(s.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const y = viewport.yToCanvas(s.lowerFresnelElevationMslM, layout);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(243, 181, 74, 0.12)';
    ctx.fill();

    // Dashed Fresnel upper and lower boundary lines
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(243, 181, 74, 0.60)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[i].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[i].upperFresnelElevationMslM, layout);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
      const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[i].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[i].lowerFresnelElevationMslM, layout);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // 2. Obstacle Screening Intervals (Authoritative structural obstacles)
  if (showObstacles && profile.obstacleIntervals && profile.obstacleIntervals.length > 0) {
    for (const obs of profile.obstacleIntervals) {
      const x1 = viewport.xToCanvas(obs.entryHorizontalDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const x2 = viewport.xToCanvas(obs.exitHorizontalDistanceM / 1000, layout);
      const bandWidth = Math.max(3, x2 - x1);

      // Vertical obstruction band
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 68, 68, 0.22)';
      ctx.fillRect(x1, padT, bandWidth, plotH);

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 80, 80, 0.85)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x1, padT);
      ctx.lineTo(x1, base);
      ctx.moveTo(x1 + bandWidth, padT);
      ctx.lineTo(x1 + bandWidth, base);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Top label
      ctx.font = '600 9.5px ui-monospace, monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8888';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      const labelX = Math.max(layout.padL + 20, Math.min(layout.width - layout.padR - 20, x1 + bandWidth / 2));
      ctx.fillText(`⊘ ${obs.obstacleId}`, labelX, padT + 12);
    }
  }

  // 3. Terrain body: Effective terrain (incorporating Earth curvature)
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padT, 0, base);
  tg.addColorStop(0, '#33465a');
  tg.addColorStop(1, '#141c26');

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(viewport.xToCanvas(samples[0].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout), base);
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[i].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
    const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[i].effectiveTerrainElevationMslM, layout);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(viewport.xToCanvas(samples.at(-1)!.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout), base);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = tg;
  ctx.fill();

  // Bare DEM elevation line (subtle dashed line below effective terrain)
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([2, 3]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140, 160, 180, 0.40)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[i].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
    const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[i].terrainElevationMslM, layout);
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  // Highlighted terrain occlusions (effective terrain > LOS ray)
  let idx = 0;
  while (idx < samples.length) {
    if (samples[idx].effectiveTerrainElevationMslM > samples[idx].losElevationMslM) {
      let j = idx;
      while (j < samples.length && samples[j].effectiveTerrainElevationMslM > samples[j].losElevationMslM) j++;

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let k = idx; k < j; k++) {
        const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[k].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
        const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[k].effectiveTerrainElevationMslM, layout);
        if (k === idx) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      for (let k = j - 1; k >= idx; k--) {
        const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[k].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
        const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[k].losElevationMslM, layout);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 112, 112, 0.42)';
      ctx.fill();

      idx = j;
    } else {
      idx++;
    }
  }

  // Effective terrain stroke outline
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = !profile.terrainIsLos ? '#ff7070' : '#7f9ab5';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) {
    const x = viewport.xToCanvas(samples[i].horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
    const y = viewport.yToCanvas(samples[i].effectiveTerrainElevationMslM, layout);
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // 4. Direct Line of Sight (LOS) Ray
  const firstSample = samples[0];
  const lastSample = samples.at(-1)!;
  const pNodeX = viewport.xToCanvas(firstSample.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
  const pNodeY = viewport.yToCanvas(firstSample.losElevationMslM, layout);
  const pAcnX = viewport.xToCanvas(lastSample.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
  const pAcnY = viewport.yToCanvas(lastSample.losElevationMslM, layout);

  ctx.strokeStyle = !profile.terrainIsLos ? '#ff7070' : '#9db4ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pNodeX, pNodeY);
  ctx.lineTo(pAcnX, pAcnY);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Terminal & ACN endpoint dots
  const drawEndpointDot = (x: number, y: number, color: string) => {
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b1015';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
  };
  drawEndpointDot(pNodeX, pNodeY, '#4fd1a1');
  drawEndpointDot(pAcnX, pAcnY, '#38bdf8');

  // Endpoint labels
  ctx.font = '600 10.5px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8ecef';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(profile.nodeName || 'Terminal', pNodeX + 8, pNodeY - 8);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('ACN', pAcnX - 8, pAcnY - 8);

  // 5. Critical Clearance Marker
  let minClearance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  let critIndex = -1;
  for (let k = 1; k < samples.length - 1; k++) {
    const clr = samples[k].effectiveTerrainClearanceM;
    if (clr < minClearance) {
      minClearance = clr;
      critIndex = k;
    }
  }

  if (critIndex >= 0 && Number.isFinite(minClearance)) {
    const critSample = samples[critIndex];
    const cx = viewport.xToCanvas(critSample.horizontalGroundDistanceM / 1000, layout);
    const cyTerrain = viewport.yToCanvas(critSample.effectiveTerrainElevationMslM, layout);
    const cyLos = viewport.yToCanvas(critSample.losElevationMslM, layout);

    const isClear = minClearance >= 0;
    const markerColor = isClear ? '#4fd1a1' : '#ff7070';

    ctx.strokeStyle = markerColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cyTerrain);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, cyLos);
    ctx.stroke();

    const sign = isClear ? '+' : '';
    const txt = `${sign}${minClearance.toFixed(0)} m`;
    ctx.font = '600 10.5px ui-monospace, monospace';
    const textWidth = ctx.measureText(txt).width + 10;
    const badgeX = cx + textWidth + 12 < layout.width - layout.padR ? cx + 6 : cx - 6 - textWidth;
    const badgeY = (cyTerrain + cyLos) / 2 - 8;

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(11, 16, 21, 0.88)';
    ctx.fillRect(badgeX, badgeY, textWidth, 16);
    ctx.strokeStyle = markerColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(badgeX, badgeY, textWidth, 16);

    ctx.fillStyle = markerColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(txt, badgeX + 5, badgeY + 12);
  }
}

function drawLegacyProfileContent(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  layout: ViewportLayout,
  viewport: LinkProfileViewportState,
  pts: readonly [number, number, number, number][],
): void {
  const { padT, padB, height: h } = layout;
  const plotH = Math.max(1, h - padT - padB);
  const base = padT + plotH;
  const last = pts.length - 1;

  // First Fresnel zone (0.6 F1 band)
  ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach((p, i) => {
    const x = viewport.xToCanvas(p[0], layout);
    const y = viewport.yToCanvas(2 * p[2] - p[3], layout);
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  });
  for (let i = last; i >= 0; i--) {
    ctx.lineTo(viewport.xToCanvas(pts[i][0], layout), viewport.yToCanvas(pts[i][3], layout));
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(243, 181, 74, 0.10)';
  ctx.fill();

  // Terrain body
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(viewport.xToCanvas(pts[0][0], layout), base);
  pts.forEach(p => ctx.lineTo(viewport.xToCanvas(p[0], layout), viewport.yToCanvas(p[1], layout)));
  ctx.lineTo(viewport.xToCanvas(pts[last][0], layout), base);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#33465a';
  ctx.fill();

  // LOS Ray
  const pNX = viewport.xToCanvas(pts[0][0], layout);
  const pNY = viewport.yToCanvas(pts[0][2], layout);
  const pAX = viewport.xToCanvas(pts[last][0], layout);
  const pAY = viewport.yToCanvas(pts[last][2], layout);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#9db4ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pNX, pNY);
  ctx.lineTo(pAX, pAY);
  ctx.stroke();
}

/**
 * Renders the dedicated Terrain Path Profile in cross-sectional PROFILE mode.
 * Highlights the effective terrain profile, bare DEM, Earth curvature, and clearance without Fresnel overlay.
 */
export function renderTerrainProfileViewport(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  layout: ViewportLayout,
  viewport: LinkProfileViewportState,
  profile: LinkProfile | null,
  legacyPoints?: readonly [number, number, number, number][] | null,
): void {
  renderLinkProfileViewport(ctx, layout, viewport, profile, legacyPoints, {
    showFresnel: false,
    titlePrefix: 'TERRAIN PROFILE',
  });
}

/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Pure Tactical Map Communication Link Style Mapping (Milestone 4 Step 3)
 *
 * Maps authoritative communication link status classifications into distinct,
 * consistent visual styles for the 2D Tactical Radar Map canvas.
 *
 * Distinguishability without relying solely on color (accessible & monochrome-safe):
 * - CONNECTED:           Solid line []
 * - DEGRADED:            Long-dashed line [7, 3]
 * - BLOCKED_TERRAIN:     Medium-dashed line [4, 4]
 * - BLOCKED_OBSTACLE:    Short-dotted line [2, 3]
 * - OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED: Spaced-dashed line [3, 6]
 * - UNKNOWN:             Sparse-dotted line [1, 5]
 */

import {
  classifyLinkCommunicationStatus,
  LinkCommunicationStatus,
  LinkStatusClassification,
  LinkStatusTelemetryInput,
} from '../core/linkStatusClassifier';

export interface MapLinkStyle {
  readonly status: LinkCommunicationStatus;
  /** Primary stroke color for background / unselected link. */
  readonly strokeColor: string;
  /** High-contrast, higher-luminance stroke color for selected terminal link. */
  readonly selectedStrokeColor: string;
  /** Stroke line width in pixels for unselected link. */
  readonly lineWidth: number;
  /** Stroke line width in pixels for selected terminal link (drawn on top). */
  readonly selectedLineWidth: number;
  /** Canvas line dash pattern (e.g. [] for solid, [4, 4] for dashed, etc.). */
  readonly lineDash: readonly number[];
  /** Color of the ground terminal node marker on the tactical map. */
  readonly nodeColor: string;
  /** Concise badge / HUD label for display in map callouts and reticles. */
  readonly statusLabel: string;
  /** Accent color for reticle bracket corners, badge pills, and callout borders. */
  readonly badgeColor: string;
  /** Human-readable description of line pattern for accessibility and tooltips. */
  readonly patternDescription: string;
}

/**
 * Authoritative visual configuration table for all 6 link statuses.
 */
export const MAP_LINK_STYLES: Readonly<Record<LinkCommunicationStatus, MapLinkStyle>> = Object.freeze({
  CONNECTED: Object.freeze({
    status: 'CONNECTED',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)', // Clear cyan
    selectedStrokeColor: '#38bdf8',           // Solid intense cyan
    lineWidth: 1.2,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.6,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([]),              // Solid line
    nodeColor: '#10b981',                     // Emerald healthy terminal
    statusLabel: 'CONNECTED',
    badgeColor: '#38bdf8',
    patternDescription: 'Solid line',
  }),

  DEGRADED: Object.freeze({
    status: 'DEGRADED',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.65)', // Amber
    selectedStrokeColor: '#fbbf24',           // Solid bright amber
    lineWidth: 1.4,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.8,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([7, 3]),          // Long dash
    nodeColor: '#f59e0b',                     // Amber terminal
    statusLabel: 'DEGRADED',
    badgeColor: '#f59e0b',
    patternDescription: 'Long-dashed line',
  }),

  BLOCKED_TERRAIN: Object.freeze({
    status: 'BLOCKED_TERRAIN',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.65)',  // Red
    selectedStrokeColor: '#f87171',           // Bright red
    lineWidth: 1.3,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.6,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([4, 4]),          // Medium dash
    nodeColor: '#ef4444',                     // Crimson terminal
    statusLabel: 'BLOCKED (TERRAIN)',
    badgeColor: '#ef4444',
    patternDescription: 'Medium-dashed line',
  }),

  BLOCKED_OBSTACLE: Object.freeze({
    status: 'BLOCKED_OBSTACLE',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.70)', // Orange
    selectedStrokeColor: '#fb923c',           // Bright tactical orange
    lineWidth: 1.5,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.8,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([2, 3]),          // Short dots
    nodeColor: '#f97316',                     // Orange terminal
    statusLabel: 'BLOCKED (OBSTACLE)',
    badgeColor: '#f97316',
    patternDescription: 'Dotted line',
  }),

  OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED: Object.freeze({
    status: 'OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.45)', // Muted slate grey
    selectedStrokeColor: '#94a3b8',           // Slate grey
    lineWidth: 1.1,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.2,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([3, 6]),          // Spaced dash
    nodeColor: '#64748b',                     // Muted grey terminal
    statusLabel: 'OUTAGE (DISCONNECTED)',
    badgeColor: '#94a3b8',
    patternDescription: 'Spaced-dashed line',
  }),

  UNKNOWN: Object.freeze({
    status: 'UNKNOWN',
    strokeColor: 'rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.35)',  // Neutral dark steel
    selectedStrokeColor: '#64748b',           // Steel grey
    lineWidth: 1.0,
    selectedLineWidth: 2.0,
    lineDash: Object.freeze([1, 5]),          // Sparse dots
    nodeColor: '#475569',                     // Dark neutral
    statusLabel: 'UNKNOWN (UNVERIFIED)',
    badgeColor: '#64748b',
    patternDescription: 'Sparse-dotted line',
  }),
});

/**
 * Returns the authoritative MapLinkStyle for a given link status.
 * Safely defaults to UNKNOWN style if status is null, undefined, or unrecognized.
 */
export function getMapLinkStyle(status: LinkCommunicationStatus | string | null | undefined): MapLinkStyle {
  if (status && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(MAP_LINK_STYLES, status)) {
    return MAP_LINK_STYLES[status as LinkCommunicationStatus];
  }
  return MAP_LINK_STYLES.UNKNOWN;
}

/**
 * Evaluates node telemetry and returns both the authoritative classification and map style.
 */
export function classifyAndStyleLink(
  nodeTelemetry: LinkStatusTelemetryInput | null | undefined
): {
  readonly classification: LinkStatusClassification;
  readonly style: MapLinkStyle;
} {
  const classification = classifyLinkCommunicationStatus(nodeTelemetry);
  const style = getMapLinkStyle(classification.status);
  return { classification, style };
}

export interface StatusBadgeInfo {
  readonly status: LinkCommunicationStatus;
  readonly badgeClass: string;
  readonly badgeText: string;
  readonly badgeColor: string;
}

/**
 * Returns consistent UI badge class and display label for a link communication status.
 */
export function getStatusBadgeInfo(
  status: LinkCommunicationStatus | string | null | undefined
): StatusBadgeInfo {
  const style = getMapLinkStyle(status as LinkCommunicationStatus);
  let badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-neutral';
  switch (style.status) {
    case 'CONNECTED':
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-cyan';
      break;
    case 'DEGRADED':
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-amber';
      break;
    case 'BLOCKED_TERRAIN':
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-crimson';
      break;
    case 'BLOCKED_OBSTACLE':
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-amber';
      break;
    case 'OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED':
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-slate';
      break;
    case 'UNKNOWN':
    default:
      badgeClass = 'kpi-badge badge-neutral';
      break;
  }
  return {
    status: style.status,
    badgeClass,
    badgeText: style.statusLabel,
    badgeColor: style.badgeColor,
  };
}

const finite = (value: unknown): value is number =>
  typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value);

export function isValidLink(node: NetworkNodeTelemetry): boolean {
  return node.link_outage === false && finite(node.snr_db);
}

export function aggregateNetworkSample(sample: NetworkPerformanceSample): NetworkAggregateSample {
  const valid = sample.nodes.filter(node => node.linkValid && finite(node.snrDb));
  const snrs = valid.map(node => node.snrDb as number);
  return {
    simulationTimeS: sample.simulationTimeS,
    averageSnrDb: snrs.length ? snrs.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / snrs.length : null,
    minimumSnrDb: snrs.length ? Math.min(...snrs) : null,
    totalRateMbps: sample.nodes.reduce((sum, node) => sum + Math.max(0, node.rateMbps), 0),
    totalTransferredMb: sample.nodes.reduce((sum, node) => sum + Math.max(0, node.transferredMb), 0),
    validLinkCount: snrs.length,
  };
}

export class NetworkPerformanceHistory {
  readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly samples: NetworkPerformanceSample[] = [];
  private readonly lastDeliveredBytes = new Map<number, number>();
  private readonly cumulativeTransferredBytes = new Map<number, number>();
  private frameCounter = 0;
  private readonly sampleEveryFrames: number;

  constructor(capacity = 600, sampleEveryFrames = 5) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(capacity) || capacity < 2) throw new Error('History capacity must be at least 2.');
    if (!Number.isInteger(sampleEveryFrames) || sampleEveryFrames < 1) throw new Error('Sample interval must be positive.');
    this.capacity = capacity;
    this.sampleEveryFrames = sampleEveryFrames;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.samples.length = 0;
    this.lastDeliveredBytes.clear();
    this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.clear();
    this.frameCounter = 0;
  }

  ingest(frame: NetworkPerformanceFrame, enabled = true): NetworkPerformanceSample | null {
    if (!enabled || !finite(frame.simulationTimeS) || !Number.isInteger(frame.frameIndex)) return null;
    this.frameCounter += 1;
    if (this.frameCounter % this.sampleEveryFrames !== 0) return null;

    const nodes = frame.nodes.map(node => {
      const delivered = node.transfer_state && finite(node.transfer_state.delivered_bytes)
        ? Math.max(0, node.transfer_state.delivered_bytes)
        : 0;
      const previous = this.lastDeliveredBytes.get(node.node_id);
      if (previous === undefined) {
        this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.set(node.node_id, (this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.get(node.node_id) ?? 0) + delivered);
      } else if (delivered >= previous) {
        this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.set(
          node.node_id,
          (this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.get(node.node_id) ?? 0) + delivered - previous
        );
      } else {
        // A lower counter marks a new transfer. Its already-delivered prefix is
        // new payload, while the previous transfer was fully accounted for.
        this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.set(
          node.node_id,
          (this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.get(node.node_id) ?? 0) + delivered
        );
      }
      this.lastDeliveredBytes.set(node.node_id, delivered);

      const rateBps = node.transfer_state && finite(node.transfer_state.current_rate_bps)
        ? Math.max(0, node.transfer_state.current_rate_bps)
        : 0;
      return {
        nodeId: node.node_id,
        snrDb: isValidLink(node) ? node.snr_db as number : null,
        rateMbps: rateBps / 1e6,
        transferredMb: (this.cumulativeTransferredBytes.get(node.node_id) ?? 0) / 1e6,
        linkValid: isValidLink(node),
      };
    });

    const sample = Object.freeze({
      frameIndex: frame.frameIndex,
      simulationTimeS: frame.simulationTimeS,
      nodes: Object.freeze(nodes),
    });
    this.samples.push(sample);
    if (this.samples.length > this.capacity) this.samples.shift();
    return sample;
  }

  getSamples(): readonly NetworkPerformanceSample[] {
    return this.samples;
  }

  getNodeIds(): readonly number[] {
    const ids = new Set<number>();
    for (const sample of this.samples) for (const node of sample.nodes) ids.add(node.nodeId);
    return [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
}

/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Authoritative Network Traffic Inventory & Communication Flow Engine
 *
 * Implements:
 * 1. Per-node traffic tracking (Uplink & Downlink) reusing authoritative simulation worker telemetry.
 * 2. Detailed flow records with mathematical consistency (sent, received, rate, SNR, packets, drops).
 * 3. Combined network aggregate summary (total throughput, payload, loss, active links, SNR metrics).
 * 4. Per-node traffic summary with communication availability & successful transfers count.
 * 5. Robust reset handling, tab-switch persistence, and dynamic node addition/deletion pruning.
 * 6. Authentic flow representation: Ground Terminal -> ACN -> Ground Terminals (no fabricated P2P).
 */

import { classifyLinkCommunicationStatus, LinkCommunicationStatus } from '../core/linkStatusClassifier';
import { getNodeRole } from './nodeInventory';

interface NodeAccumulator {
  lastDeliveredBytes: number;
  lastDroppedBytes: number;
  lastDroppedPackets: number;
  cumulativeSentBytes: number;
  cumulativeDeliveredBytes: number;
  cumulativePacketsSent: number;
  cumulativePacketsReceived: number;
  cumulativePacketsLost: number;
  successfulTransfers: number;
  lastActivitySimTimeS: number | null;
  framesWithComms: number;
  totalFramesSeen: number;
  lastTransferStatus: string | null;

const finite = (val: unknown): val is number =>
  typeof val === 'number' && Number.isFinite(val);

/**
 * Authoritative tracker maintaining mathematically consistent counters across simulation frames.
 */
export class NetworkTrafficTracker {
  private readonly nodeAccumulators = new Map<number, NodeAccumulator>();
  private lastSimTimeS = 0;
  private cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes = 0;

  public clear(): void {
    this.nodeAccumulators.clear();
    this.lastSimTimeS = 0;
    this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes = 0;
  }

  private getOrCreateAccumulator(nodeId: number): NodeAccumulator {
    let acc = this.nodeAccumulators.get(nodeId);
    if (!acc) {
      acc = {
        lastDeliveredBytes: 0,
        lastDroppedBytes: 0,
        lastDroppedPackets: 0,
        cumulativeSentBytes: 0,
        cumulativeDeliveredBytes: 0,
        cumulativePacketsSent: 0,
        cumulativePacketsReceived: 0,
        cumulativePacketsLost: 0,
        successfulTransfers: 0,
        lastActivitySimTimeS: null,
        framesWithComms: 0,
        totalFramesSeen: 0,
        lastTransferStatus: null,
      };
      this.nodeAccumulators.set(nodeId, acc);
    }
    return acc;
  }

  /**
   * Synchronizes node accumulators with the current active node list, removing stale accumulators.
   */
  public prune(activeNodeIds: readonly number[]): void {
    const activeSet = new Set(activeNodeIds);
    for (const id of this.nodeAccumulators.keys()) {
      if (!activeSet.has(id)) {
        this.nodeAccumulators.delete(id);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Ingests a telemetry frame, updating cumulative metrics without double-counting.
   */
  public ingest(frame: NetworkTrafficFrame): void {
    if (!finite(frame.simulationTimeS)) return;
    this.lastSimTimeS = frame.simulationTimeS;

    const activeNodeIds = frame.nodes.map(n => n.node_id);
    this.prune(activeNodeIds);

    // Track downlink broadcast bytes if downlink telemetry is active
    const dl = frame.downlinkTelemetry;
    if (dl && dl.broadcast_active !== false) {
      const dlMs = dl.dl_duration_ms ?? 3.0;
      // Approximate 20 ms superframe portion dedicated to downlink broadcast
      // Standard 10 MHz X-band downlink channel: ~15 Mbps nominal broadcast capacity
      const nominalDlBps = 15e6;
      const dlSec = dlMs / 1000.0;
      this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes += Math.floor((nominalDlBps * dlSec) / 8);
    }

    for (const node of frame.nodes) {
      const acc = this.getOrCreateAccumulator(node.node_id);
      acc.totalFramesSeen += 1;

      const commStatus = classifyLinkCommunicationStatus(node);
      const isCommsAvailable = commStatus.status === 'CONNECTED' || commStatus.status === 'DEGRADED';
      if (isCommsAvailable) {
        acc.framesWithComms += 1;
      }

      const tx = node.transfer_state;
      if (tx) {
        const delivered = finite(tx.delivered_bytes) ? Math.max(0, tx.delivered_bytes) : 0;
        const droppedBytes = finite(tx.dropped_bytes) ? Math.max(0, tx.dropped_bytes) : 0;
        const droppedPkts = finite(tx.dropped_packets) ? Math.max(0, tx.dropped_packets) : 0;
        const total = finite(tx.total_bytes) ? Math.max(0, tx.total_bytes) : 0;

        // Detect new transfer start / counter reset
        if (delivered < acc.lastDeliveredBytes || (acc.lastTransferStatus === 'ACKNOWLEDGED' && tx.status === 'TRANSMITTING')) {
          // New transfer begun
          acc.lastDeliveredBytes = 0;
          acc.lastDroppedBytes = 0;
          acc.lastDroppedPackets = 0;
        }

        const deltaDelivered = Math.max(0, delivered - acc.lastDeliveredBytes);
        const deltaDroppedBytes = Math.max(0, droppedBytes - acc.lastDroppedBytes);
        const deltaDroppedPkts = Math.max(0, droppedPkts - acc.lastDroppedPackets);

        acc.cumulativeDeliveredBytes += deltaDelivered;
        acc.cumulativeSentBytes += (deltaDelivered + deltaDroppedBytes);
        acc.cumulativePacketsLost += deltaDroppedPkts;

        // Packet estimation: 1,200 bytes per tactical IP packet (QoS profile average)
        const pktsDelivered = Math.floor(deltaDelivered / 1200) + (deltaDelivered > 0 && deltaDelivered < 1200 ? 1 : 0);
        acc.cumulativePacketsReceived += pktsDelivered;
        acc.cumulativePacketsSent += (pktsDelivered + deltaDroppedPkts);

        acc.lastDeliveredBytes = delivered;
        acc.lastDroppedBytes = droppedBytes;
        acc.lastDroppedPackets = droppedPkts;

        if (tx.status === 'TRANSMITTING' || deltaDelivered > 0) {
          acc.lastActivitySimTimeS = frame.simulationTimeS;
        }

        if (tx.status === 'ACKNOWLEDGED' && acc.lastTransferStatus !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED') {
          acc.successfulTransfers += 1;
          acc.lastActivitySimTimeS = finite(tx.ack_time_s) ? tx.ack_time_s : frame.simulationTimeS;
        }

        acc.lastTransferStatus = tx.status ?? null;
      } else {
        // No active transfer, baseline link activity check
        if (node.is_transmitting) {
          acc.lastActivitySimTimeS = frame.simulationTimeS;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Generates the flow records for all active communication links.
   */
  public getFlowRecords(frame: NetworkTrafficFrame): TrafficFlowRecord[] {
    const records: TrafficFlowRecord[] = [];

    // 1. Uplink Flows: Each registered ground node -> ACN Relay
    for (const node of frame.nodes) {
      const acc = this.getOrCreateAccumulator(node.node_id);
      const callsign = node.name || `S${node.node_id}`;
      const commStatus = classifyLinkCommunicationStatus(node);

      const tx = node.transfer_state;
      const rateMbps = tx && finite(tx.current_rate_mbps)
        ? Math.max(0, tx.current_rate_mbps)
        : (tx && finite(tx.current_rate_bps) ? Math.max(0, tx.current_rate_bps / 1e6) : 0);

      const isTx = Boolean(node.is_transmitting || (tx && tx.status === 'TRANSMITTING'));
      const snr = finite(node.snr_db) && node.snr_db > -90 ? node.snr_db : null;

      records.push({
        id: `flow-ul-${node.node_id}`,
        fromId: node.node_id,
        fromName: `Node ${node.node_id} (${callsign})`,
        toId: 'ACN',
        toName: 'ACN Relay (FL500)',
        direction: 'Uplink',
        dataSentBytes: acc.cumulativeSentBytes,
        dataReceivedBytes: acc.cumulativeDeliveredBytes,
        dataRateMbps: Number(rateMbps.toFixed(2)),
        snrDb: snr !== null ? Number(snr.toFixed(1)) : null,
        linkStatus: commStatus.status,
        linkStatusText: commStatus.status.replace(/_/g, ' '),
        packetsSent: acc.cumulativePacketsSent,
        packetsReceived: acc.cumulativePacketsReceived,
        packetsLost: acc.cumulativePacketsLost,
        lastActivitySimTimeS: acc.lastActivitySimTimeS,
        isTransmitting: isTx,
      });
    }

    // 2. Downlink Flow: ACN Relay -> Ground Terminals (Broadcast)
    if (frame.nodes.length > 0) {
      const validLinks = frame.nodes.filter(n => {
        const s = classifyLinkCommunicationStatus(n).status;
        return s === 'CONNECTED' || s === 'DEGRADED';
      });

      const avgSnr = validLinks.length > 0
        ? validLinks.reduce((sum, n) => sum + (n.snr_db ?? 0), 0) / validLinks.length
        : null;

      // Downlink throughput during broadcast phase
      const dlDurationMs = frame.downlinkTelemetry?.dl_duration_ms ?? 3.0;
      const dlRateMbps = validLinks.length > 0 ? (15.0 * (dlDurationMs / 20.0)) : 0.0;

      records.push({
        id: 'flow-dl-broadcast',
        fromId: 'ACN',
        fromName: 'ACN Relay (FL500)',
        toId: 'BROADCAST',
        toName: `Ground Terminals (${validLinks.length}/${frame.nodes.length} in LOS)`,
        direction: 'Downlink',
        dataSentBytes: this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes,
        dataReceivedBytes: Math.floor(this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes * (validLinks.length / Math.max(1, frame.nodes.length))),
        dataRateMbps: Number(dlRateMbps.toFixed(2)),
        snrDb: avgSnr !== null ? Number(avgSnr.toFixed(1)) : null,
        linkStatus: validLinks.length > 0 ? 'CONNECTED' : 'OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED',
        linkStatusText: validLinks.length > 0 ? 'BROADCAST ACTIVE' : 'NO NODES IN LOS',
        packetsSent: Math.floor(this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes / 1200),
        packetsReceived: Math.floor(this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes * (validLinks.length / Math.max(1, frame.nodes.length)) / 1200),
        packetsLost: 0,
        lastActivitySimTimeS: this.lastSimTimeS > 0 ? this.lastSimTimeS : null,
        isTransmitting: validLinks.length > 0,
      });
    }

    return records;
  }

  /**
   * Generates per-node summary statistics.
   */
  public getPerNodeSummary(nodeId: number, frame: NetworkTrafficFrame): PerNodeTrafficSummary | null {
    const node = frame.nodes.find(n => n.node_id === nodeId);
    if (!node) return null;

    const acc = this.getOrCreateAccumulator(nodeId);
    const callsign = node.name || `S${node.node_id}`;
    const role = getNodeRole(node.node_id, node.node_type);
    const commStatus = classifyLinkCommunicationStatus(node);

    const tx = node.transfer_state;
    const uploadRateMbps = tx && finite(tx.current_rate_mbps)
      ? Math.max(0, tx.current_rate_mbps)
      : (tx && finite(tx.current_rate_bps) ? Math.max(0, tx.current_rate_bps / 1e6) : 0);

    const isCommsAvailable = commStatus.status === 'CONNECTED' || commStatus.status === 'DEGRADED';
    const dlDurationMs = frame.downlinkTelemetry?.dl_duration_ms ?? 3.0;
    const downloadRateMbps = isCommsAvailable ? Number((15.0 * (dlDurationMs / 20.0)).toFixed(2)) : 0.0;

    const availabilityPct = acc.totalFramesSeen > 0
      ? Number(((acc.framesWithComms / acc.totalFramesSeen) * 100).toFixed(1))
      : (isCommsAvailable ? 100.0 : 0.0);

    const snr = finite(node.snr_db) && node.snr_db > -90 ? node.snr_db : null;

    // Estimate received downlink portion for this node based on availability
    const rxBytes = Math.floor(this.cumulativeDlBroadcastBytes * (availabilityPct / 100.0));

    return {
      nodeId: node.node_id,
      callsign,
      role,
      totalDataTransmittedBytes: acc.cumulativeSentBytes,
      totalDataReceivedBytes: rxBytes,
      currentUploadRateMbps: Number(uploadRateMbps.toFixed(2)),
      currentDownloadRateMbps: downloadRateMbps,
      totalSuccessfulTransfers: acc.successfulTransfers,
      snrDb: snr !== null ? Number(snr.toFixed(1)) : null,
      linkStatus: commStatus.status,
      communicationAvailabilityPct: availabilityPct,
      activeLinksCount: isCommsAvailable ? 1 : 0,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Generates combined network aggregate summary strictly consistent with individual records.
   */
  public getCombinedNetworkSummary(records: readonly TrafficFlowRecord[]): CombinedNetworkSummary {
    let totalSent = 0;
    let totalReceived = 0;
    let totalUlRate = 0;
    let totalDlRate = 0;
    let activeLinks = 0;
    let totalDeliveries = 0;
    let totalLost = 0;
    const validSnrs: number[] = [];

    for (const r of records) {
      totalSent += r.dataSentBytes;
      totalReceived += r.dataReceivedBytes;
      if (r.direction === 'Uplink') {
        totalUlRate += r.dataRateMbps;
        if (r.linkStatus === 'CONNECTED' || r.linkStatus === 'DEGRADED') {
          activeLinks += 1;
        }
        if (finite(r.snrDb)) {
          validSnrs.push(r.snrDb);
        }
      } else {
        totalDlRate += r.dataRateMbps;
      }
      totalLost += r.packetsLost;
    }

    for (const acc of this.nodeAccumulators.values()) {
      totalDeliveries += acc.successfulTransfers;
    }

    const avgSnr = validSnrs.length > 0
      ? Number((validSnrs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / validSnrs.length).toFixed(1))
      : null;
    const minSnr = validSnrs.length > 0
      ? Number(Math.min(...validSnrs).toFixed(1))
      : null;

    return {
      totalPayloadTransmittedBytes: totalSent,
      totalPayloadReceivedBytes: totalReceived,
      totalUplinkThroughputMbps: Number(totalUlRate.toFixed(2)),
      totalDownlinkThroughputMbps: Number(totalDlRate.toFixed(2)),
      activeCommunicationLinksCount: activeLinks,
      totalSuccessfulDeliveries: totalDeliveries,
      totalPacketsLost: totalLost,
      averageSnrDb: avgSnr,
      minimumSnrDb: minSnr,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Presentation formatters
 */
export function formatTrafficBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!finite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0.00 KB';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`;
}

export function formatTrafficRate(rateMbps: number): string {
  if (!finite(rateMbps) || rateMbps <= 0) return '0.00 Mbps';
  return `${rateMbps.toFixed(2)} Mbps`;
}

export function formatTrafficSimTime(timeS: number | null): string {
  if (!finite(timeS) || timeS === null || timeS < 0) return '—';
  return `T+${timeS.toFixed(2)}s`;
}

export function formatTrafficSnr(snrDb: number | null): string {
  if (!finite(snrDb) || snrDb === null) return '—';
  return `${snrDb > 0 ? '+' : ''}${snrDb.toFixed(1)} dB`;
}

export function getTrafficStatusBadge(status: LinkCommunicationStatus): { label: string; badgeClass: string } {
  switch (status) {
    case 'CONNECTED':
      return { label: 'CONNECTED', badgeClass: 'badge-emerald' };
    case 'DEGRADED':
      return { label: 'DEGRADED', badgeClass: 'badge-amber' };
    case 'BLOCKED_TERRAIN':
      return { label: 'TERRAIN BLOCKED', badgeClass: 'badge-crimson' };
    case 'BLOCKED_OBSTACLE':
      return { label: 'OBSTACLE BLOCKED', badgeClass: 'badge-crimson' };
    case 'OUTAGE_DISCONNECTED':
      return { label: 'OUTAGE', badgeClass: 'badge-neutral' };
    default:
      return { label: 'UNKNOWN', badgeClass: 'badge-neutral' };
  }
}

/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Feature 7 — Configurable Ground-Node AGL UI Controller
 *
 * Implements frontend validation, state synchronization, spatial-lock blocking,
 * historical mode locking, and command formatting for per-node Antenna AGL (0.0 to 1000.0 m).
 */

import {
  MIN_GROUND_AGL_M,
  MAX_GROUND_AGL_M,
  DEFAULT_ANTENNA_AGL_M,
} from '../shared/constants';

export { MIN_GROUND_AGL_M, MAX_GROUND_AGL_M };
export const DEFAULT_GROUND_AGL_M = DEFAULT_ANTENNA_AGL_M;

export interface AglValidationResult {
  readonly valid: boolean;
  readonly value?: number;
  readonly reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Validates candidate Antenna AGL input.
 * Strictly enforces finite numeric values within [0.0, 1000.0] metres.
 */
export function validateNodeAgl(val: unknown): AglValidationResult {
  if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'AGL value cannot be empty.' };
  }
  const num = typeof val === 'number' ? val : parseFloat(String(val).trim());
  if (!Number.isFinite(num)) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Antenna AGL must be a finite number.' };
  }
  if (num < MIN_GROUND_AGL_M || num > MAX_GROUND_AGL_M) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      reason: `Antenna AGL must be between ${MIN_GROUND_AGL_M.toFixed(1)} and ${MAX_GROUND_AGL_M.toFixed(1)} metres.`,
    };
  }
  return { valid: true, value: num };
}

export interface AglEditEligibility {
  readonly canEdit: boolean;
  readonly reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Checks whether editing Antenna AGL is permitted under current simulation state.
 * Blocks editing when:
 * 1. Historical inspection is active.
 * 2. Spatial lock is enabled.
 * 3. Target node is ACN (node_id -1) or outside 0..15 range.
 */
export function checkAglEditEligibility(options: {
  readonly spatialLocked: boolean;
  readonly isHistorical: boolean;
  readonly nodeId: number;
}): AglEditEligibility {
  if (options.isHistorical) {
    return {
      canEdit: false,
      reason: 'Cannot edit AGL in historical inspection mode. Return to LIVE to edit.',
    };
  }
  if (options.spatialLocked) {
    return {
      canEdit: false,
      reason: 'Spatial lock is enabled; disable spatial lock to edit Antenna AGL.',
    };
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(options.nodeId) || options.nodeId < 0 || options.nodeId >= 16) {
    return {
      canEdit: false,

/**
 * Tactical X-Band Air-to-Ground Network Digital Twin
 * Node Inventory Display & Geographic Coordinate Resolver
 *
 * Implements authoritative validation and presentation formatting for ground-node
 * inventory rows. Strictly displays valid WGS-84 geographic coordinates emitted by
 * the authoritative simulation worker, and displays an explicit unavailable indicator ('—')
 * whenever telemetry coordinates are absent, non-numeric, or outside valid geodetic bounds.
 *
 * NEVER derives or fabricates latitude/longitude from local Cartesian X/Y coordinates in the UI.
 */

import { formatDmsComponent } from '../core/geodesy';

export interface FormattedGeodeticCoordinates {
  readonly latStr: string;
  readonly lonStr: string;
  readonly latDms: string;
  readonly lonDms: string;
  readonly hasValidGeo: boolean;
  readonly latDeg?: number;
  readonly lonDeg?: number;
}

/**
 * Validates and formats geographic coordinates for node inventory presentation.
 * Returns explicit '—' / 'Unavailable' indicators if either coordinate is missing or invalid.
 *
 * @param latDeg Candidate latitude in degrees from worker telemetry
 * @param lonDeg Candidate longitude in degrees from worker telemetry
 */
export function formatNodeGeodeticCoordinates(
  latDeg: unknown,
  lonDeg: unknown
): FormattedGeodeticCoordinates {
  const isValidLat =
    typeof latDeg === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(latDeg) &&
    latDeg >= -90.0 &&
    latDeg <= 90.0;

  const isValidLon =
    typeof lonDeg === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(lonDeg) &&
    lonDeg >= -180.0 &&
    lonDeg <= 180.0;

  if (!isValidLat || !isValidLon) {
    return {
      latStr: '—',
      lonStr: '—',
      latDms: 'Unavailable',
      lonDms: 'Unavailable',
      hasValidGeo: false,
    };
  }

  const latHemi = latDeg >= 0 ? 'N' : 'S';
  const lonHemi = lonDeg >= 0 ? 'E' : 'W';
  const latStr = `${Math.abs(latDeg).toFixed(5)}°${latHemi}`;
  const lonStr = `${Math.abs(lonDeg).toFixed(5)}°${lonHemi}`;
  const latDms = formatDmsComponent(latDeg, true);
  const lonDms = formatDmsComponent(lonDeg, false);

  return {
    latStr,
    lonStr,
    latDms,
    lonDms,
    hasValidGeo: true,
    latDeg,
    lonDeg,
  };
}

/**
 * Resolves standard tactical role label for a registered ground node ID.

export function getNodeRole(nodeId: number, nodeType?: string): string {
  if (nodeType === 'mcp' || nodeId === 15) return 'Main Command Post (20W Dish)';
  if (nodeId === 4) return 'Recon Patrol (Occlusion Target)';
  if (nodeId === 1) return 'Squad Leader (Voice Lead)';
  if (nodeId === 2) return 'Medic (Voice MC-PTT)';
  if (nodeId === 3 || nodeId === 6 || nodeId === 9) return 'Scout (Tactical Video)';
  return 'Soldier Terminal';
}

  OBSTACLE_WORLD_LIMIT_M, Obstacle, normalizeObstacle,
} from '../core/obstacles';
import { GROUND_NODE_IDS } from '../core/config';

export type ObstacleMapMode = 'navigate' | 'select' | 'place';
export interface ObstructionSnapshot {
  readonly node_id: number;
  readonly terrain_is_los: boolean;
  readonly obstacle_blocked: boolean;
  readonly obstacle_intersections: readonly { readonly obstacleId: string; readonly entryFraction: number; readonly exitFraction: number; readonly penetrationM: number }[];
  readonly link_outage: boolean;
  readonly bitrate_bps: number;
  readonly modcod_name: string;
  readonly predicted_state: string;
  readonly time_to_occlusion_s: number;
  readonly time_to_emergence_s: number;
  readonly is_shadowed: boolean;
}
export interface ObstacleCommandResult {
  readonly type: 'COMMAND_RESULT';
  readonly command_type: string;
  readonly request_id?: string | number;
  readonly accepted: boolean;
  readonly reason?: string;
  readonly spatial_locked: boolean;
  readonly obstacle_set?: readonly Obstacle[];
  readonly obstruction_state?: readonly ObstructionSnapshot[];
}

const cloneObstacle = (o: Obstacle): Obstacle => ({ ...o });
const cloneSet = (items: readonly Obstacle[]): Obstacle[] => items.map(cloneObstacle);
const cloneSnapshot = (items: readonly ObstructionSnapshot[]): ObstructionSnapshot[] => items.map(item => ({
  ...item, obstacle_intersections: item.obstacle_intersections.map(hit => ({ ...hit })),
}));
const isNumber = (value: unknown): value is number => typeof value === 'number' && !Number.isNaN(value);
const PREDICTION_STATES = new Set([
  'NORMAL_LOS', 'PRE_OCCLUSION_FLUSH', 'HARD_SHADOW_CUTOFF', 'RE_EMERGENCE_BURST',
]);

function isValidObstructionSnapshot(value: unknown): value is readonly ObstructionSnapshot[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length !== GROUND_NODE_IDS.length) return false;
  const seenIds = new Set<number>();
  const entriesValid = value.every((entry: unknown) => {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') return false;
    const item = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (!Number.isInteger(item.node_id) || !GROUND_NODE_IDS.includes(item.node_id as number) ||
        seenIds.has(item.node_id as number) ||
        typeof item.terrain_is_los !== 'boolean' || typeof item.obstacle_blocked !== 'boolean' ||
        !Array.isArray(item.obstacle_intersections) || typeof item.link_outage !== 'boolean' ||
        typeof item.bitrate_bps !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(item.bitrate_bps) || item.bitrate_bps < 0 ||
        typeof item.modcod_name !== 'string' || item.modcod_name.length === 0 ||
        typeof item.predicted_state !== 'string' || !PREDICTION_STATES.has(item.predicted_state) ||
        !isNumber(item.time_to_occlusion_s) || item.time_to_occlusion_s < 0 ||
        !isNumber(item.time_to_emergence_s) || item.time_to_emergence_s < 0 ||
        typeof item.is_shadowed !== 'boolean') return false;
    const intersectionsValid = item.obstacle_intersections.every((rawHit: unknown) => {
      if (!rawHit || typeof rawHit !== 'object') return false;
      const hit = rawHit as Record<string, unknown>;
      return typeof hit.obstacleId === 'string' && hit.obstacleId.length > 0 &&
        typeof hit.entryFraction === 'number' && Number.isFinite(hit.entryFraction) && hit.entryFraction >= 0 && hit.entryFraction <= 1 &&
        typeof hit.exitFraction === 'number' && Number.isFinite(hit.exitFraction) && hit.exitFraction >= hit.entryFraction && hit.exitFraction <= 1 &&
        typeof hit.penetrationM === 'number' && Number.isFinite(hit.penetrationM) && hit.penetrationM >= 0;
    });
    if (intersectionsValid) seenIds.add(item.node_id as number);
    return intersectionsValid;
  });
  return entriesValid && seenIds.size === GROUND_NODE_IDS.length;

/** Shared spatial hit priority; node targets win, then the active spatial tool, then map pan. */
export function resolveSpatialCanvasTarget(
  nodeDistancePx: number,
  waypointDistancePx: number,
  obstacleDistancePx: number,
  obstacleMode: ObstacleMapMode,
  waypointActive: boolean,
  nodeRadiusPx = 16,
  editRadiusPx = 12,
): 'node' | 'obstacle' | 'waypoint' | null {
  if (nodeDistancePx <= nodeRadiusPx) return 'node';
  if (obstacleMode !== 'navigate') return obstacleDistancePx <= editRadiusPx ? 'obstacle' : null;
  if (waypointActive && waypointDistancePx <= editRadiusPx) return 'waypoint';
  return null;

/** UI state only: the worker remains authoritative for committed geometry and obstruction. */
export class ObstacleEditorState {
  private committedSet: Obstacle[] = [];
  private draftSet: Obstacle[] = [];
  private obstructionSet: ObstructionSnapshot[] = [];
  private selected: string | null = null;
  private pending: string | null = null;
  private locked = false;
  private obstructionIsCurrent = false;
  private idCounter = 0;
  public mode: ObstacleMapMode = 'navigate';
  public placementShape: Obstacle['shape'] = 'cuboid';
  public message = 'Obstacle edits are previews until applied.';

  public get committed(): readonly Obstacle[] { return cloneSet(this.committedSet); }
  public get draft(): readonly Obstacle[] { return cloneSet(this.draftSet); }
  public get selectedId(): string | null { return this.selected; }
  public get pendingRequestId(): string | null { return this.pending; }
  public get spatialLocked(): boolean { return this.locked; }
  public get obstructionSnapshot(): readonly ObstructionSnapshot[] { return cloneSnapshot(this.obstructionSet); }
  public get obstructionSnapshotIsCurrent(): boolean { return this.obstructionIsCurrent; }

    const obstacle = this.draftSet.find(o => o.id === this.selected);

  }

  public setSpatialLock(locked: boolean): void {
    if (this.locked === locked) return;
    this.locked = locked;
    this.message = locked ? 'Spatial lock is on. Draft is read-only until unlocked.' : 'Spatial lock is off.';
  }

  public setMode(mode: ObstacleMapMode): void { this.mode = mode; }
  public setPlacementShape(shape: Obstacle['shape']): void { this.placementShape = shape; }

  public select(id: string | null): void {
    this.selected = id !== null && this.draftSet.some(o => o.id === id) ? id : null;
  }

  public create(shape: Obstacle['shape'], xM: number, yM: number): string {
    this.assertEditable();
    if (this.draftSet.length >= MAX_OBSTACLES) throw new Error(`Obstacle set cannot exceed ${MAX_OBSTACLES} items.`);
    const id = this.nextId();
    const input = shape === 'cone'
      ? { id, shape, xM, yM, radiusM: 50, heightM: 50 }
      : { id, shape, xM, yM, widthM: 100, depthM: 100, heightM: 50, rotationDeg: 0 };
    const obstacle = normalizeObstacle(input);
    this.draftSet = [...this.draftSet, obstacle];
    this.selected = id;
    this.message = 'Obstacle added to draft. Apply to commit it.';
    return id;
  }

  public move(id: string, xM: number, yM: number): void {
    this.assertEditable();
    const obstacle = this.require(id);
    this.replaceDraft(id, { ...obstacle, xM, yM } as Obstacle);
  }

  public updateSelected(patch: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.assertEditable();
    if (!this.selected) throw new Error('Select an obstacle first.');
    this.require(this.selected);
    // Keep malformed in-progress numeric edits in the draft so Apply can report
    // the core validator's message without changing committed worker state.
    this.draftSet = this.draftSet.map(o => o.id === this.selected ? { ...o, ...patch } as Obstacle : o);
    try { this.validate(); this.message = 'Draft updated. Apply to commit it.'; }
    catch (error) { this.message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid obstacle.'; }
  }

  public deleteSelected(): void {
    this.assertEditable();
    if (!this.selected) throw new Error('Select an obstacle first.');
    this.draftSet = this.draftSet.filter(o => o.id !== this.selected);
    this.selected = this.draftSet.at(-1)?.id ?? null;
    this.message = 'Obstacle removed from draft. Apply to commit the removal.';
  }

  public validate(): string | null {
    try {
      if (this.draftSet.length > MAX_OBSTACLES) throw new Error(`Obstacle set cannot exceed ${MAX_OBSTACLES} items.`);
      const ids = new Set<string>();
      for (const item of this.draftSet) {
        const obstacle = normalizeObstacle(item);
        if (ids.has(obstacle.id)) throw new Error(`Duplicate obstacle id '${obstacle.id}'.`);
        ids.add(obstacle.id);
      }
      return null;
    } catch (error) { return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid obstacle set.'; }
  }

  public beginApply(requestId: string): readonly Obstacle[] {
    this.assertEditable();
    if (this.pending) throw new Error('An obstacle update is already pending.');
    const error = this.validate();
    if (error) { this.message = error; throw new Error(error); }
    const normalized = this.draftSet.map(item => normalizeObstacle(item));
    this.pending = requestId;
    this.message = 'Applying obstacle set to simulation worker…';
    return cloneSet(normalized);
  }

  public reconcile(result: ObstacleCommandResult): boolean {
    // Apply responses are the only synchronization path. Ignore unsolicited,
    // stale, malformed, or unrelated results before touching any editor state.
    if (result.type !== 'COMMAND_RESULT' || result.command_type !== 'OBSTACLES_REPLACE') return false;
    if (this.pending === null || typeof result.request_id !== 'string' || result.request_id !== this.pending) return false;
    if (typeof result.accepted !== 'boolean' || typeof result.spatial_locked !== 'boolean' ||
        !Array.isArray(result.obstacle_set) || !isValidObstructionSnapshot(result.obstruction_state)) return false;

    // Stage copies and validation before committing the response, so malformed
    // response data cannot partially change the committed set or snapshot.
    let nextCommitted: Obstacle[];
    let nextObstruction: ObstructionSnapshot[];
    try {
      nextCommitted = result.obstacle_set.map(item => normalizeObstacle(item));
      nextObstruction = cloneSnapshot(result.obstruction_state);
    } catch (_) { return false; }

    this.committedSet = nextCommitted;
    this.obstructionSet = nextObstruction;
    this.obstructionIsCurrent = true;
    this.pending = null;
    this.draftSet = cloneSet(this.committedSet);
    if (this.selected && !this.draftSet.some(o => o.id === this.selected)) this.selected = null;
    this.message = result.accepted ? 'Obstacle set committed by the simulation worker.' : `Worker rejected obstacle set: ${result.reason || 'Invalid obstacle set.'}`;
    this.locked = result.spatial_locked;

  public markSimulationFrameAdvanced(): void { this.obstructionIsCurrent = false; }

  public cancel(): void {
    if (this.pending) throw new Error('Wait for the worker to finish the current obstacle update.');
    this.draftSet = cloneSet(this.committedSet);
    if (this.selected && !this.draftSet.some(o => o.id === this.selected)) this.selected = null;

  }

    this.message = 'Draft updated. Apply to commit it.';
  }

  private require(id: string): Obstacle {
    const obstacle = this.draftSet.find(o => o.id === id);
    if (!obstacle) throw new Error('Selected obstacle no longer exists.');
    return obstacle;
  }

  private assertEditable(): void {
    if (this.locked) throw new Error('Spatial lock is on. Obstacle geometry is read-only.');
    if (this.pending) throw new Error('Wait for the worker to finish the current obstacle update.');
  }

  private nextId(): string {
    let id: string;
    do { id = `obstacle-${++this.idCounter}`; } while (this.draftSet.some(o => o.id === id));
